needs.name: Seabed depth and relief
needs.reason: Eleven original NOAA BAG footprints near Anacapa and eastern Santa Cruz have native 1–4 m MLLW depth, product uncertainty and a conservative <=200 ft screen. Other island terrain views remain context; complete coastal coverage is not claimed.

needs.name: Rock, sand, mud and habitat edges
needs.reason: Actual NOAA historical hard/soft island footprints clipped to native source-depth masks and closures, plus CDFW historical constructed reefs. Variable source accuracy; not a boulder inventory.

needs.name: Underwater imagery and samples
needs.reason: Regional data not imported. No neighboring region’s evidence is reused.

needs.name: Kelp canopy and vegetated habitat
needs.reason: Actual CDFW canopy and subsurface detections from September 2016, including Catalina. Historical context only; no live kelp claim.

needs.name: Protected-area boundaries
needs.reason: Complete regional CDFW MPA snapshot plus NOAA’s eight Groundfish Exclusion Areas. Context areas also excluded from closures.

needs.name: Species, season, size, bag and gear rules
needs.reason: Southern jurisdiction: seasonal 50-fathom legal line, species sublimits and daily official-source checks.

needs.name: In-season, health, whale-risk and security restrictions
needs.reason: CDFW in-season, health and gear watches plus NOAA exclusion areas. Navy/security access around islands requires direct local clearance.

needs.reason: NOAA GFS Wave and ECMWF WAM at regional sea-grid samples.
